title: Norwegian Fish Cakes
description: A simple and delicious Norwegian dish made with cod, onions, and flour. Serve with a side of tartar sauce.
instructions: Rinse the cod and cut it into small pieces.
In a bowl, mix together the cod, onion, flour, springy, yummy, and a pinch of salt.
Shape the mixture into small patties.
Wrap each patty in puff pastry and seal the edges.
Place the fish cakes on a baking sheet and brush with a little water.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve hot with a side of tartar sauce.
